title: Azure Foundry IRL capability learning catalog
content_notice: Original fictional scenarios and learning metadata only. These concepts are not deployed demos or verified product-availability claims.

capabilities.title: Choose a model by evidence
capabilities.summary: Start with a measurable task, then weigh quality, latency, and cost instead of choosing by a leaderboard alone.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional workshop needs concise handover notes without losing dates or unresolved decisions.
capabilities.business_value: Decide whether less manual rewriting is worth the operating cost and review effort.
capabilities.architecture_note: Separate the task contract from the model adapter so a later comparison does not require redesigning the application.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Draft a scoring rubric for factual retention, brevity, and explicit uncertainty using the synthetic note.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Factual omissions, reviewer corrections, latency distribution, and measured cost per accepted result.
guardrails: Use only synthetic notes in this foundation.
Require current model, region, license, and pricing verification before an experiment.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Workshop note: The fictional Lantern review moved to Thursday. The owner of the packing checklist is still undecided.

capabilities.title: Give an agent a bounded job
capabilities.summary: Explore where a tool-using workflow helps, and where an explicit application step remains the safer choice.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional studio wants a preparation assistant to assemble a meeting checklist without sending invitations.
capabilities.business_value: Reduce coordination effort while keeping consequential actions under human control.
capabilities.architecture_note: Keep orchestration separate from tool authorization; a model choosing a tool is not permission to run it.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Draw the permitted steps and identify the first action that would require human approval.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Task completion, unnecessary tool choices, approval requests, and recovery from tool failure.
guardrails: No tools or agent runtime are connected.
Future execution needs server-side authorization and bounded tool permissions.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Task: prepare a review checklist. Allowed: read fictional agenda metadata. Disallowed: send invitations or modify calendars.

capabilities.title: Make an answer traceable
capabilities.summary: Treat retrieval quality and answer grounding as separate questions, with evidence a reviewer can inspect.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional exhibit team needs answers about its invented handling rules, with a path back to the relevant passage.
capabilities.business_value: Help a reviewer distinguish a supported answer from a confident guess.
capabilities.architecture_note: Design document boundaries, access filtering, retrieval, and citation rendering before adding generation.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Match the synthetic question to its supporting sentence, then write an abstention for a question the text cannot answer.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Retrieval relevance, unsupported claims, citation correctness, and appropriate abstention.
guardrails: Only fictional source passages are published.
Future retrieval must enforce document authorization before context reaches a model.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Source: Fictional glass tokens travel in padded boxes. Question: How should the tokens travel? Unsupported question: Who insured the shipment?

capabilities.title: Turn a document into reviewable data
capabilities.summary: Plan extraction around an explicit schema, confidence handling, and a human correction path.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional archive wants to capture a label identifier and handling instruction from invented exhibit labels.
capabilities.business_value: Reduce rekeying while preserving a clear exception path for uncertain fields.
capabilities.architecture_note: Preserve the relationship between each extracted field and its source location; do not treat extraction as validation.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Define required fields and decide which missing or ambiguous values must stop downstream processing.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Field-level accuracy, missing-field rate, correction time, and source-location fidelity.
guardrails: No image upload or document processing is implemented.
Future files need type, size, retention, privacy, and content checks.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Fictional label: Item LANTERN-007; material paper; handling keep flat. This is authored input text, not an OCR result.

capabilities.title: Design a voice interaction people can leave
capabilities.summary: Consider transcription, response timing, interruption, and a text alternative as one interaction contract.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional visitor kiosk needs a short spoken directions flow with an equally useful text experience.
capabilities.business_value: Explore accessibility and convenience without making voice the only way to complete a task.
capabilities.architecture_note: Separate audio capture, transcription, response generation, and playback; define cancellation across the whole chain.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Annotate the synthetic script with an interruption point, a confirmation step, and a text fallback.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Time to first useful response, transcription errors, interruption behavior, and fallback completion.
guardrails: No microphone access, recording, or speech service is connected.
Future audio requires consent, retention limits, and verified voice-use permissions.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Visitor: Where is the paper exhibit? Kiosk script: Follow the fictional Lantern signs. Text fallback: Show the same directions on screen.

capabilities.title: Give generated media a review contract
capabilities.summary: Define intent, rights, disclosure, and acceptance criteria before considering an image or video workflow.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional learning team wants a storyboard for an invented paper-lantern exhibit, not a publish-ready asset.
capabilities.business_value: Explore faster concept discussion while keeping editorial and rights decisions with people.
capabilities.architecture_note: Treat prompts, generated artifacts, provenance, moderation, and approval as distinct records.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Write a constrained creative brief and identify what a reviewer must verify before publication.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Brief adherence, review rejection reasons, accessibility text quality, and provenance completeness.
guardrails: No media generation or upload is implemented.
Future use needs current model availability, usage rights, safety review, and disclosure checks.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Original creative brief: three storyboard panels showing an abstract paper lantern, neutral labels, no people, no brands, and no photorealistic claims.

capabilities.title: Earn the decision to fine-tune
capabilities.summary: Distinguish a missing fact, a weak instruction, and a repeatable behavior gap before proposing model adaptation.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional operations team wants consistent formatting for invented maintenance summaries.
capabilities.business_value: Avoid training expense when a clearer contract or retrieval design would solve the actual problem.
capabilities.architecture_note: Keep training, validation, and holdout sets separate; compare against an explicit prompting baseline.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Classify the synthetic error as a formatting issue, a knowledge gap, or an ambiguous requirement.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Holdout improvement, regression rate, data lineage, training cost, and rollback criteria.
guardrails: No training data upload or fine-tuning job exists.
Future adaptation requires rights-cleared data and verified model-specific support.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Required format: issue | action | owner. Fictional error: a summary omits the owner field even when the source explicitly names role A.

capabilities.title: Make trust an observable decision
capabilities.summary: Connect evaluation cases, safety boundaries, operational traces, and cost evidence to a release decision.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional project board needs to decide whether an assistant concept is ready for a limited, approved trial.
capabilities.business_value: Replace a polished anecdote with explicit acceptance criteria and visible unresolved risks.
capabilities.architecture_note: Plan telemetry redaction and correlation before adding traces; operational logs are not automatically safe to publish.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Define a release-blocking failure and a synthetic test that would reveal it.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Task success, unsafe behavior, unsupported claims, failed requests, and cost against the approved allowance.
guardrails: No cloud telemetry, safety service, or certification is connected.
Future logs need privacy review; passing a small test set is not a safety guarantee.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Synthetic case: the source omits an answer. Expected behavior: state the missing evidence, not invent a fact. This is a proposed test, not a recorded result.

capabilities.title: Put a permission boundary around every tool
capabilities.summary: Explore MCP and API integration contracts without confusing tool discovery with authorization.
capabilities.scenario: A fictional workspace wants read-only lookup of invented exhibit metadata, with no business-system credentials in a browser.
capabilities.business_value: Identify reusable integration patterns while limiting what a future assistant could access or change.
capabilities.architecture_note: Keep secrets and authorization on the backend, validate tool inputs, and enforce least privilege independently of the prompt.
capabilities.learning_exercise: Sketch a read-only tool schema and name the server-side check that rejects an unauthorized object identifier.
capabilities.evidence_to_collect: Authorization denials, schema validation failures, tool latency, audit coverage, and secret exposure checks.
guardrails: No MCP server, enterprise API, or credential is connected.
Future integrations require identity, scoped consent, egress controls, and auditable authorization.
capabilities.synthetic_example: Proposed read-only contract: lookup_exhibit(exhibit_id='LANTERN-007'). No endpoint or tool execution is provided by this foundation.
